description.value: Lift Bar Grill View is a waterfront fine dining restaurant on Vancouver's Coal Harbour, offering sweeping views of the harbour, Stanley Park, and the coastal mountains from the city's only waterfront rooftop deck. The menu focuses on regionally sourced West Coast cuisine and Pacific seafood, paired with an award-winning BC and Pacific Northwest wine list. Floor-to-ceiling windows that open in summer and outdoor fire features make it a distinctive stop for cyclists passing through the Coal Harbour seawall corridor.
